name: Proekcija menja
source:
Sora wakes up in a small room with soft walls resembling a psychiatric hospital isolation ward. He realizes that he does not remember anything until this moment, and the man behind the door is in no hurry to tell anything. From his mouth, the child learns only his name and place of residence.
However, did you know that you can communicate with your consciousness, just like with a real person? And importantly, it can help you find the answers.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-385]AniVisual.net[/url]]
